title: field-consumer rule: an object-form relatedLists column name is credited to the declaring object, so an undisplayed parent field with the same name stays silent
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2uhJ1AYNPw5TUSVS

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing and a measured control. Source: fleet. Found in contract review 7187700473 (S2) on PR #37428 (#36945); the seat ordered it filed under #36945 (REWORK 7187715426).

Grading: area:build · Bug · missed finding × builders (a field nothing displays is not reported) → suggested p2 · reach: `os validate` / `os lint` field-consumer rule · evidence: measured by the PR's own control.

## What is wrong

The field-consumer rule credits the column names of an object-form `relatedLists` entry to the object that DECLARES the list (the parent), not to the child object the columns belong to. A parent field that nothing displays therefore stays silent whenever a child's related-list column has the same name.

Measured on PR #37428 (head 973207ca): with the field-consumer controls, 7 of 12 blank-template controls stay green until the helper drops the name from every related list. `withoutPlacement` in `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.test.ts` now strips those columns on every object, which keeps that control honest today and also hides this defect from it.

## Done when

- A related-list column is credited to the child object it names, not to the declaring parent; a parent field with the same name and no other consumer is reported.
- A test pins both directions (parent field reported; the child's own column still counts as a consumer).
- `withoutPlacement` is narrowed back so the blank-template control exercises the fixed rule.

## Who acts

The owner of the field-consumer rule (lint / `os validate`); the template test helper rides.

Dedupe: `relatedLists columns consumer`, `field-consumer related list` → no open card.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#36945.
